build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: The player character leaves a visible wet ink trail while moving. After a short delay (approximately 1 second), the wet ink solidifies into a walkable platform that supports the player's weight. Score 0 if no trail mechanic exists.

An ink meter limits trail creation — when empty, movement leaves no trail. Ink wells placed in levels refill the meter. The meter is visible and depletes proportionally to trail length created. Score 0 if ink is unlimited or no resource management exists.

The player can stand on their own solidified ink trails — crossing gaps by running through air, then doubling back to stand on the hardened trail. This self-scaffolding is the core puzzle mechanic. Score 0 if the player cannot interact with their own trails.

The solidification delay creates timing puzzles — the player must draw a trail mid-jump and land on it after it hardens. Mistiming results in falling through wet ink. Score 0 if trails solidify instantly with no timing element.

Levels have a clear exit goal. A three-star rating based on ink efficiency (less ink used = better rating) encourages optimal routing. The rating is displayed on level completion. Score 0 if no goal or rating exists.

At least 18 levels across 6 worlds are present with unique puzzle layouts requiring different ink-trail strategies. Levels within a world share a theme but vary in challenge. Score 0 if fewer than 10 levels exist.

Advanced mechanics are introduced in later worlds: wind that displaces wet ink before hardening, erasers that dissolve trail sections, timed ink that fades after seconds, or color-coded ink. At least 3 distinct advanced mechanics exist. Score 0 if only basic trail mechanics exist throughout.

Worlds introduce mechanics progressively — early worlds teach basic trail-platforming, later worlds layer complexity. Each world has a distinct visual theme and mechanical focus. Score 0 if no progressive introduction exists.

Ink well placement is strategic — wells are sparse enough to force efficient routing but present enough to prevent soft-locks. Some levels have multiple possible solutions with different ink costs. Score 0 if ink wells are everywhere or absent.
Level completion shows ink used, time, and star rating. A world-select screen shows progress and total stars. Score 0 if no completion tracking exists.
A styled title screen shows ink dripping into the game name with thematic art. A world-select grid is accessible. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> world select -> level -> completion -> back to select without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.

During gameplay, the ink meter is prominently displayed, wet vs solid trail states are visually distinct (different color or opacity), and the exit goal is clearly marked. Score 0 if no ink meter or trail state distinction is visible.
Readability at 1280x720 is strong: the player, wet ink, solid ink, ink wells, hazards, and level geometry are all clearly distinguishable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, worlds, ink effects, and UI — a consistent ink/watercolor aesthetic with fluid visual language. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Environments use real sprite or tile art for level geometry, backgrounds, and ink wells — not plain ColorRect fills. Ink trails have a fluid, organic appearance. Different worlds have distinct visual themes. Score 0 if environments are uniform color fills.
HUD and UI chrome: ink meter, star rating, world select, and completion screens use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: ink flows fluidly from the character, solidification has a visible hardening effect, ink wells bubble when approached, wind visibly displaces wet ink, and level completion has a satisfying animation. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
